build_coco_dataset: build a COCO-style pose dataset by instantiating BaseCocoStyleDataset with an annotation file and data prefix
load_annotations_topdown: load COCO annotations in topdown mode where each sample contains one person instance with keypoints
load_annotations_bottomup: load COCO annotations in bottomup mode grouping all instances per image into a single data sample
parse_data_info: parse raw COCO annotation dicts into structured data info with bbox, keypoints, and visibility arrays
filter_data_bbox_score: filter dataset annotations by bbox_score threshold using filter_cfg to remove low-confidence detections
